title: REMAX Unveils New Hot Air Balloon, Draws Attention at World’s Largest Balloon Event
summary: The refreshed REMAX hot air balloon made its U.S. debut at the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta, 48 years after making its debut at the same festival.
body_markdown:
All eyes were on the skies above Albuquerque, New Mexico, as hundreds of vibrant hot air balloons lifted off during the annual Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta. In the crisp morning air and against a backdrop of sweeping desert landscapes and colors, one familiar icon returned to the event with a fresh new look.


A newly redesigned REMAX Hot Air Balloon, one of the most recognizable symbols in real estate, took to the skies in its U.S. debut. While the iconic red, white and blue color scheme remains, the updated balloon design reflects the modern REMAX branding.


As the balloon inflated and slowly rose above the launch field, it quickly became a welcomed, familiar sight among the hundreds of balloons that filled the sky.


REMAX agent Joslyn Wood with REMAX Professionals in Lawton, Oklahoma, was attending the Fiesta, eagerly hoping for a glimpse of the iconic balloon.


“Seeing the REMAX Balloon here has filled me with pride and excitement.”


A real estate professional for 10 years, Wood says her enthusiasm for the brand extends well beyond the balloon itself.


“Anytime I see the logo, whether it’s on an advertisement, a business card or a T-shirt, I always feel that same sense of pride,” she says.


The REMAX Hot Air Balloon fleet is one of the largest corporate hot air balloon fleets in the world, appearing at festivals, parades, school events and charitable initiatives throughout the year. For many, seeing the balloon in person is a memorable experience.


For REMAX Hot Air Balloon pilot Ryan Duff, the debut was especially meaningful.


“My dad used to fly for REMAX when I was a kid, and I’ve been flying for REMAX myself for about four years now,” Duff says. “After months of anticipation, it was incredible to watch the balloon inflate for the first time in its new design. It feels modern and sleek while still honoring such an iconic brand. I’m proud to be part of bringing it to life in the sky.”


Among the event’s spectators with no direct connection to real estate, the REMAX balloon’s debut sparked recognition and nostalgia.


Daniel Romero of Rio Rancho, New Mexico, was attending the Fiesta for his 10th year when the newly designed REMAX balloon caught his attention, bringing back memories of home.


“I’m originally from Colorado, and we used to see the REMAX balloon flying all the time,” Romero says. “Kind of reminds me of home a little bit.


“It’s bold \[and\] bright. It’s very noticeable, and it’s just an iconic balloon.”


As it floated above Albuquerque among hundreds of colorful aircraft, the REMAX balloon served as a fresh expression of a familiar icon. Rooted in a 50-year legacy and recognized around the world, the balloon remains a powerful symbol of a brand that continues to stand out, both on the ground and in the sky.


**Source: MMR Strategy Group study of unaided awareness.*


Written by **REMAX News**
